source_format: ArcGIS FeatureServer query; Assessor also sells GIS shapefile downloads via paid subscription

policy.summary: Douglas County Assessor offers parcel GIS shapefiles as a fee-based subscription download (subscriptions@douglascountyor.gov). A public Parcels FeatureServer is also reachable and includes owner/value fields. Fee-gated official downloads plus no open redistribution clause found means public CDN re-host and commercial derive-and-sell are not cleared. Get written terms before Grant B. Always use PROP_ID (not TAXID) as join_field.
policy.terms_notes: Database Downloads page: subscription fee-based service for downloadable formats including Geoparcels/Parcels shapefiles. No public-domain/CC grant located on that page.

viewer_outline.notes: Official parcel downloads are fee/subscription; no clause allowing customer-visible lot lines in a third-party product.

workflow_clip.notes: Fee-gated + no open commercial-processing grant. Clip-in-workflow not cleared until written terms (use PROP_ID join).

notes: Douglas collision: never label as bare Douglas. Viewer tiles exist; pipeline-gap.

retrieval_log.detail: counties.json: https://gis.co.douglas.or.us/server/rest/services/Parcel/Parcels/FeatureServer/0 via download_arcgis_taxlots.py douglas. Id must stay douglas-or (not CO/WA).
returnCountOnly → 68858. maxRecordCount 50000. Fields include NAME/ADDR*/ASSD_VALUE/MARKET_VALUE — strip. Native CRS EPSG:2270.

Paginate FeatureServer/0/query where=1=1 outFields=OBJECTID,TAXID,PROP_ID,ACCT_ACREAGE,TotalAcreage returnGeometry=true outSR=4326 f=geojson. Join PROP_ID only. Optional paid shapefile path via Assessor subscriptions — still needs redistribution language for CDN.
Classified unknown; derive_and_sell=false given fee subscription packaging and missing open license.
Split product rights into viewer_outline (customer-visible lot line) and workflow_clip (server-side clip/PIP). Both remain allowed=false pending written clearance.
